content.question: Which two assumptions does Linear Discriminant Analysis make?
options: Each class has its own covariance matrix and the decision boundary is quadratic.
The margin between classes must be maximal and kernels must be polynomial.
All features must be conditionally independent and the data must be textual.
Every class follows a multivariate normal distribution and all classes share a common covariance matrix.
content.answer: Every class follows a multivariate normal distribution and all classes share a common covariance matrix.
